summary: Unit tests for new functionality are comprehensive, covering edge cases and using appropriate mocking. Code follows project patterns, no critical issues found.

suggestions.issue: Some tests rely on exact HTML structure; consider using more flexible selectors.
suggestions.impact: Tests may break if the target website changes its HTML (though mocked).
suggestions.recommendation: Use more generic selectors or extract test HTML into fixtures.

suggestions.issue: Mocking of Telegram API could be more granular to test error scenarios.
suggestions.impact: Limited coverage of edge cases like network timeouts.
suggestions.recommendation: Add tests for specific TelegramError subtypes.
